This name is derived from the Arabic word 'jabal', meaning mountain, and the suffix 'ah' which denotes femininity. In Islamic tradition, mountains are considered sacred places, symbolizing closeness to the divine. The name Jibalah carries a sense of spiritual connection and devotion to Allah.
